title: metadata-protocol: the /meta/:type/:name/layers 409 for a package-scoped refusal carries no details.candidates, unlike the plain read (ADR-0150 D5; sibling of closed #32201)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

Filing category: ① product defect with a named location (an out-of-scope finding from the #32354 build, measured on `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` plus the #32354 local head; notes `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/card-32354/step0.md`).
Part of #31527 (ADR-0150) · Refs #32201 · Refs #32354

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：按名字读元数据分层（`/meta/:type/:name/layers`）遇到多个包持有同名项而拒绝时，409 也要带 `details.candidates`，与普通读一致。
- 为什么：#32201 让普通读的 409 带上候选包，但分层读的 409 只有一句话，调用方无法知道该选哪个包。
- 风险：第一方 0 处；只是在已有的 409 上加一个字段（放宽，Clause-② yes）。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol` 中 `/layers` 的拒绝出口（`packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` 一带），对照 #32201 在普通读上的做法。
- 验证：两个包持有 d1，`GET /meta/:type/d1/layers` 应答 409，且 `details.candidates` 列出两个包。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## What happens

A package-scoped refusal on `/layers` answers 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT with a sentence naming the holders, but no structured `details.candidates`. This holds both for two registry holders and for the row-layer refusals #32354 adds. The plain read at the same address carries `details.candidates` since #32201. D5 says every ambiguous by-name answer names its candidates.

## Do

Carry the candidates, in the `/actions` shape, on every `/layers` refusal exit, on both transports. Pin each exit and ablate once. CONTROL: the plain read is unchanged.

Serial: after #32354, which adds row-layer `/layers` refusals.
Blocked-by: #32354
Reader who acts: the server seat the epic seat routes it to. Grade: p2 (first-party reach 0).
